ad_info.reference_style: Christmas lifestyle product ad with hero product, icon column and model holding the product
ad_info.angle_used: Self-gift for Christmas: treat yourself to natural curves (natural support, no surgery)

global_identity.color_palette: Primary: hot fuchsia #E6177F and deep magenta #B0105E. Secondary: bottle black #0E0E10, bubblegum pink #FF8CC0, pale blush pink #FBE3EE and white #FFFFFF. Small accents only: warm metallic gold #C9A227 for the round seal, and classic Christmas red #C8102E only on the Santa hat and the knitted socks. Same contrast logic as the reference: light warm background, black and fuchsia text, fuchsia as the accent.
global_identity.visual_style: Premium Latin American beauty-supplement Christmas ad: ultra-photorealistic Colombian woman photographed naturally, the black-and-fuchsia bottle as hero, clean fuchsia icon circles, soft cozy holiday living room kept clean and uncluttered.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Feminine, confident, warm and festive; soft warm daylight with gentle Christmas bokeh, believable real-life moment.
global_identity.graphic_language: Fuchsia circles with thin white line icons, rounded fuchsia pill labels and banner, one round gold seal, handwritten script accents, soft blush-pink and white background with minimal decoration.
global_identity.text_typography: Typography of the reference: small opener in a black casual slanted brush/marker script; huge first headline word in an extra-heavy geometric sans serif, uppercase (Montserrat Black), fuchsia; second headline line in the same family Bold uppercase, black, about 40% of the first word's height; subtitle and icon labels in a clean sans serif sentence case (Montserrat Medium), dark charcoal; emotional side note in a white casual handwritten script; gift tag in a black handwritten script; bottom banner in white Medium uppercase sans.

creative_objective: Recreate the winning Christmas ad layout exactly with the user's own bottle, changing only the headline to a warmer 'treat yourself' word and the natural benefit, while keeping every text compliant (support for her curves, no promises of growth).

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) the huge fuchsia headline word with its black second line, 2) the woman kneeling with the bottle, 3) the large hero bottle, 4) the four icon benefits, 5) the small two-photo card, gift tag and bottom fuchsia banner.
art_direction.composition_style: Left 45%: full-body woman. Right 55%: headline stack on top, icon column plus hero bottle in the middle, two-photo card under the icons, gift box at bottom right. Bottom center: wide fuchsia pill banner.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Generous margins, headline block clearly separated from the icon column, icons evenly spaced vertically, nothing important touching the edges. The longer level-1 word keeps the same height and fits within the right half.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Soft warm indoor daylight, shallow depth of field on the background tree, the bottle sharp with a soft contact shadow, gentle highlights on the glossy pink cap.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Woman kneeling on a white fluffy rug on the left, three-quarter rear view, looking back over her shoulder, holding the bottle near her shoulder; Christmas tree blurred at far left. Top right: script opener, huge fuchsia uppercase word, black uppercase line, two-line subtitle. Over the left middle: white handwritten note. Middle right: vertical column of four fuchsia icon circles with labels; to its right the big hero bottle with pink capsules at its base and a round gold seal at its upper right. Under the icons: small card with two mini photos, pill labels and an arrow. Bottom right: gift box with a handwritten tag. Bottom center: wide fuchsia pill banner with white text. Brand logo at top right of the reference is removed.

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 Christmas lifestyle supplement ad, recreating exactly this layout. LEFT 45% OF THE CANVAS: an ultra-photorealistic young Colombian Latina woman in her mid-twenties with long straight dark-brown hair, kneeling on a white fluffy faux-fur rug in a three-quarter rear view, her body turned away from the camera and her face looking back over her shoulder with a soft confident smile; she wears a classic red-and-white Santa hat, a fuchsia #E6177F fitted bralette top, fitted white ribbed lounge shorts with a small fuchsia bow at the hip, and knee-high red-and-white knitted Christmas socks; her full body is visible from head to feet, natural and tasteful pose, realistic anatomy, real skin texture, no zoom on any body part. With her right hand raised near her shoulder she holds one product bottle with the label facing the camera. BACKGROUND: at the far left a softly blurred decorated Christmas tree with warm fairy lights and two wrapped gifts at its base; the rest is a clean, softly lit pale blush-pink #FBE3EE and white living-room wall with gentle warm bokeh, uncluttered. Over the left-middle area, beside the woman, a short white casual handwritten script note on four lines (text_block_05). TOP RIGHT (right 55%, top 35%): the headline stack, centered within the right half: first a black slanted brush-marker script opener (text_block_01); right below it a huge extra-heavy uppercase fuchsia #E6177F word (text_block_02), the largest element of the ad, fitting the width of the right half; below it a bold black uppercase line about 40% of that height (text_block_03); below it a centered two-line dark-charcoal sentence-case subtitle ending with a small fuchsia heart (text_block_04). MIDDLE RIGHT: a vertical column of four evenly spaced fuchsia circles with thin white line icons (a curved feminine silhouette, a leg with motion lines, a vitamin drop, two capsules), each with a short dark-charcoal two-line label to its right (text_block_06 to text_block_09). To the right of that column, standing on the rug level, the LARGE HERO PRODUCT BOTTLE, about 40% of the canvas height, sharp and front-facing, with five glossy pink capsules lying at its base, and a round warm-gold metallic seal with a laurel ring overlapping the upper right shoulder of the bottle, showing text_block_10 in dark lettering. BELOW THE ICON COLUMN, center-right: a small white rounded card holding two side-by-side mini photos, each with a fuchsia pill label on top (text_block_11 left, text_block_12 right) and a small curved fuchsia arrow between them; left mini photo: the same woman, small and full body, in gray leggings doing a squat with a light dumbbell in a bright room; right mini photo: the same woman in a fuchsia lounge set smiling and holding the bottle. BOTTOM RIGHT CORNER: a fuchsia wrapped gift box with a white satin ribbon bow and a cream kraft gift tag hanging from it, slightly tilted, with a black handwritten note (text_block_13). BOTTOM CENTER: a wide fuchsia #E6177F rounded pill banner with white uppercase text ending in a small white heart (text_block_14). PRODUCT (both the hero bottle and the one in her hand): A matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, with a glossy hot-pink/magenta screw cap printed with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' wordmark pattern, and a solid hot-pink band wrapping the bottom fifth of the bottle. The black label shows, from top to bottom: a small pink VITALABH emblem with the white word 'VITALABH'; a huge bold white condensed word 'AGUAJE'; the line 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1' with 'COMPLEX' in white and '3 EN 1' in pink-red; a thin hot-pink banner reading 'SUPLEMENTO ALIMENTICIO EN CÁPSULAS'; a small white line 'A base de Aguaje, Fenogreco y Maca Negra'; a bold italic hot-pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' with a pink swoosh underline; three small black rounded boxes outlined in pink joined by white plus signs reading '200mg AGUAJE', '400mg FENOGRECO' and '200mg MACA NEGRA'; and at the bottom '60 CÁPSULAS | (0.5 g c/u Cont. Neto 30g)' in small white type. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the product: do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it. Do not place any brand logo in the top right corner; leave that area as clean background. Soft warm daylight, premium clean finish. Do not add CTA buttons, price badges, rating stars, testimonials, extra badges, bottom bars or any text block not listed.
